decided: When an archive commits a file from the change's folder that git never tracked, the archive names that file in one line of its report on the pull request, so the user sees it was pushed.
alternatives: leave the missing line as a known gap for a later change
stop committing such files with the archive
why: The archive's requirement already says such a file is committed with the archived folder and named, so the user sees every file pushed with the archive; the user chose to fix it in this change.
detail: src/core/pr/tail.ts observations.carried_untracked: paths under the archived directory with no tracked counterpart at the pre-move path (HEAD's tree or the index), the archive emit excluded; PR_ARCHIVE_TAIL_REFERENCE names it.
